svg.text: Layer 0: base. Fn is held for layer 1
Layers 2 and 3 (System 2) start as copies of 0 and 1. DIP switches can change some keys (see the DIP switch picture).
Layer 1: Fn held. Blank keys fall through to layer 0
Chords: hold Fn + Ctrl, then the key (never sent to the host)
• Pair a slot: Fn + Ctrl + Q (blue blinks twice a second), then Fn + Ctrl + 1-4.
• Forget a slot: Fn + Ctrl + Q, then hold Fn + Ctrl + BS and press 1-4.
• Forget all: Fn + Ctrl + Q, then hold Fn + Ctrl + BS and press Z.
